content.title: How to Get Last-Minute Coachella Passes for Both Weekends of the Sold-Out 2026 Festival
content.text: Skip to main content site categories Home Music Music News How to Get Last-Minute Coachella Passes for Both Weekends of the Sold-Out 2026 Festival As weekend one approaches, here's everything to know about securing tickets — and at a discount — with THR-exclusive promo codes. Coachella Courtesy of Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission. Coachella weekend one passes were the first to go. Weekend two followed shortly thereafter. While 2026 tickets (for April 10 to 12 and April 17 to 19) have been sold out on the festival’s official site since September 2025, aspiring festivalgoers can still find tickets (plus camping and shuttle passes) on third-party resale platforms, namely StubHub, TicketNetwork, Vivid Seats, Ticket Liquidator, SeatGeek and Gametime. When comparing resale platforms, StubHub stands out for its large inventory, while TicketNetwork offers the best THR-exclusive promotion: $150 off $500 and up with code THR150, and $300 off $1,000 and up with code THR300 at TicketNetwork.com. The Hollywood Reporter‘s additional promo codes are listed directly below. Related Stories Discount Codes for 2026 Coachella Tickets TicketNetwork, Vivid Seats and SeatGeek are offering exclusive deals to THR readers: TicketNetwork: Get $150 off orders of $500 and up with promo code THR150, or $300 off $1,000 and up with code THR300. Vivid Seats: Use code THR30 to save $30 on purchases of $300 and above. SeatGeek: New customers can use promo code HOLLYWOOD10 to save $10 on purchases of $250 and up. At a Glance: How to Buy Coachella 2026 Passes When: April 10-12 and April 17-19, 2026 Location: Empire Polo Club, Indio, California Buy Tickets Online: StubHub, TicketNetwork, Vivid Seats, Ticket Liquidator, SeatGeek, Gametime Where to Buy Sold-Out 2026 Coachella Festival Passes for Weekends One and Two In addition to the THR-exclusive promo codes from TicketNetwork, Vivid Seats and SeatGeek, resale platforms StubHub, Ticket Liquidator and Gametime also have a select number of passes to catch Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G live (scroll for the full 2026 lineup and confirmed weekend one set times). Learn more about each ticketing site — and their corresponding promo codes — below. Inventory is extremely limited, so act fast. Note: Since pricing and inventory are constantly fluctuating, we didn’t include current pricing details below, and recommend checking each of the six sites listed (TicketNetwork, Vivid Seats, StubHub, Ticket Liquidator, SeatGeek and Gametime) to compare costs at time of purchase. StubHub With the most expansive resale inventory, StubHub has a number of weekend one and weekend two Coachella passes still on sale. TicketNetwork TicketNetwork has 2026 Coachella passes, and right now, THR readers can get $150 off orders of $500 and up with promo code THR150, or $300 off $1,000 and up with code THR300. Vivid Seats Vivid Seats has tickets available to the 2026 festival. Use code THR30 to save $30 on purchases of $300 and above at vividseats.com. Ticket Liquidator Ticket Liquidator has 2026 Coachella passes, and as the name suggests, the site specializes in discount tickets and cheap seats to major concerts, Broadway shows and sporting events. SeatGeek Find tickets to the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at SeatGeek. New customers can use promo code HOLLYWOOD10 to save $10 on purchases of $250 and up. Gametime Finally, a limited number of Coachella 2026 tickets are available at Gametime for both weekend one and two. Coachella 2026 Lineup Sabrina Carpenter will headline on Friday, Justin Bieber on Saturday and Karol G on Sunday. Anyma is also set to deliver the world premiere of what’s being called “Anyma presents Æden.” Other artists set for Coachella 2026 include Teddy Swims, KATSEYE, Central Cee, Sexyy Red, Ethel Cain, Dijon, the XX, Disclosure, Nine Inch Noize, The Strokes, Giveon, Addison Rae, Labrinth, Sombr, Swan Lee, Royel Otis, David Byrne, Young Thug, BIGBANG, Laufey, Major Lazer, Iggy Pop, FKA Twigs and Subtronics. See the full 2026 festival lineup below. Coachella 2026 Set Times: Weekend One Set times for weekend one of Coachella 2026 were announced on Monday, April 6, available via Coachella’s official website and Instagram. Along with set times came the announcement that Jack White is a last-minute addition to weekend one’s schedule, confirmed to play the Mojave stage at 3 p.m on Saturday, April 11. Last year, both Weezer and Ed Sheeran were brought onto the bill to play the same stage and time slot for weekend one and two, respectively.
